propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture calls git fetch origin tickets with capture_output=True and check=True, causing CalledProcessError to discard git's stderr and report only exit status 128
git fetch, archive, and ls-tree calls in the fixture lack diagnostic context: the failure reason is unrecoverable from the error message alone
git fetch is an unretried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, so transient failures cause hard test errors
new run_git helper must capture output, check the exit status, and raise RuntimeError carrying the joined command, exit status, and verbatim stderr
fetch_tickets helper must retry the fetch a bounded number of times (FETCH_ATTEMPTS=3) with backoff before final failure, implementing retry-then-fail policy rather than silent skip
unit tests with stubbed subprocess.run must verify the error message contains stderr plus remote/branch/status, that transient failures retry and succeed, and that attempt count is bounded
